■ Stage Direction
Age: 15
Personality: Gentle

■ Stage Direction
1 sec silence at start

Running drills on an unstable sandy beach certainly helps build core strength.
According to her trainer, her goal is: form improvement through core strengthening.

Could it be! Is your mom a Tracen Academy alumna, missy?!
The famous one who made her mark in the Triple Tiara route...!

Ah~... I see. Sorry for being so pushy!
I'll invite you again, so don't overdo it! See ya~!

Since when, and for how long, had she been running drills?
...Even as my thoughts raced, I found myself calling out to her.

Whoa! Thank you so much~!
...Hey, what are we doing after this? Should we head to the nearby mall after all?!

I'll do my very best! As much as I possibly can!
And then, someday—

The whole time during the training camp, every single day, she was soaked in sweat and covered in mud.
Seeing her work so tirelessly and passionately... You couldn't help but respect her.

Never in my life have I managed to do anything with effortless finesse.
I lack quick wit, I can only think of plain ideas, and my proposals are strictly pragmatic.

Are you... a rookie trainer without an assigned trainee? Th-That's pretty rare.
It's sweltering, the work is exhausting, and they dump all the chores on you, so almost none of 'em come out here.

And after she debuted, she actually ran in the Triple Tiara races!
Incredible, ain't it? All three of 'em—the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Oaks), and the Shuka Sho!

I knew it! Ah, so that girl's daughter is already all grown up!
Time sure flies... Do your best just like your mother did! I'll be cheering for you!

Yes, I will do my best.
Now, if you will excuse me... I must be going.

Air Messiah turns and walks away. Tracking her departing figure with my eyes,
I take a breath and ask the old man a question.

Huh?
Ah... yes, Trainer.

Oh, wow...! Mother!
I will treasure this and read every single word.

Oh... Could it be that my running here
is getting in the way of your duties?

Wait, but wasn't your assignment for today... Whoa!
Did you really write this equipment check report in so much detail...?

I'm in~! The brutal training camp has barely just begun, after all.
Refreshing ourselves is super important♪

Aahaha! Calling me 'gentleman' kinda tickles, honestly.
Ah, come to think of it, someone called me that before, too... Wait, huh? Huhhh?!

Oh, is that so?
Thank you for working so hard so early in the morning, Trainer.

...In the distance, the cheerful voices of the girls enjoying the beach could be heard.
In the midst of that, the sight of her silently sweating away all by herself left a lasting impression on me.

No, thank you. I have already had my fill.
It was truly delicious, kind sir.

I am glad to hear that. ...Now, I must resume my run.
Please excuse me.

Ah... Air Messiah. She did mention she wanted to incorporate
more core training to improve her running form, but—

See, core workouts are really unglamorous, and above all, utterly grueling.
To devote herself so silently and completely to it... you've gotta admire that.
And yet, because 'being earnest' is truly my only redeeming quality—

I took the phrase 'Rookie trainer attendance recommended' far too seriously
and came all the way to this summer camp. Thinking about that makes me let out another sigh.
Yes. I will do my best. —Excuse me.

Ahaha! A senior told me that a rough outline is totally fine, you know?
More importantly, what do you say to yakiniku! The trainee who landed a scout contract yesterday is coming too!
...Still, man. Every single one of them was so painfully close.

Messiah, here you are. The training journal you said you wanted to see.
It's full of old notes from my younger days, though... will it be all right?

That's how it is. ...Man, oh man, but still...
Remembering it all like this makes me realize just how much that girl resembles her mother.

Oh... so you knew my mother.
Yes, I am her daughter, Air Messiah.

'I do it because it must be done.' In the chilly air of early morning,
steam was practically rising from her sweat-drenched body.

Hm? ...Oh, you mean that girl's mother? Man,
they're identical. The spitting image of her. Especially that earnest demeanor.

And so, most of the Umamusume headed out to take a breather.
...However—
Are you... assigned as a trainer to someone?

Having finished my work, I return to my room in the trainer dormitory... and let out a deep sigh.
The incident in the gym storehouse flashes through my mind. ...I've done it again.

One, two, three... One, two, three, four, five...
One, two, three... One, two, three, four, five...

Let's see... Alright, everyone in our group is here.
Then let's get started, first move to the beach—! ...Wait, whoa?!

Alright, bringing in another rice cooker! Anyone wanting seconds, come on up!
Eat hearty to prepare for tomorrow! Come on, you over there too, young lady!
Someday, I too—just like Mother.

I bet young Messiah is a hard worker too, isn't she?
Her mother was the exact same way. I remember it vividly.

Haah, haah...! Haah, haah, haah...
—Phew.

Yeah. She placed 3rd in the Oka Sho, 2nd in the Oaks, and 3rd in the Shuka Sho,
if I remember right. In the end, she never reached that GⅠ victory... It must've been heartbreaking.

Haah, haah, phew...!
Just... five more kilometers...!

Early the next morning.
Heading down to the beach to prepare for training...

Ah, there you are! Finally found you~! Hey, all of us rookie trainers
are heading out for yakiniku to exchange info, wanna join?

—Alright, that wraps it up for today! You have free time until dinner.
Make sure everyone replenishes their water and salt properly!
